claims.text: Built for how a child learns

beats.note: no catalog effect covers a missing-capability list without inventing UI; drawn pair of lesson cards shows no swap control on a wrong answer and no bins for unsorted items, camera keeps pushing in

points: Zoom in to reveal the right answer
Swap a wrong answer for the right one
Sort items into their own bins

beats.note: archetype-only finale: the camera reaches full zoom on a 3x3 grid of the nine teaching effects, filling the frame — no page/hub backdrop
